name: The Burden of Creative Genius
description: When your Aino, who has this card equipped, is on the field, and you trigger an Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged, Bloom, or Lunar-Bloom reaction: Deal +2 DMG for this instance and attach Empowerment to the 1 card with the highest Current Elemental Dice Cost from your Hand. (Once per Round)
